prompts.name: 01-lamellendach-pergola
prompts.prompt:
Use case: compositing / ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished premium German advertising poster for KLOTZ, portrait 3:4, ideally 1536 x 2048 pixels. This is the first master in a matching five-poster campaign for a modern architectural website.
INPUT ROLES: image 1 is the old flyer being redesigned and its two base prices; image 2 is the clean REAL photograph to insert; image 3 is the exact existing blue KLOTZ logo to preserve. Do not use image 1's blue background, circles, collage or typography.
ART DIRECTION: restrained Swiss architectural editorial design, warm paper #f3f2eb, graphite #202822, muted forest green, small lime #d9ed97 accent. Large confident Manrope-like sans-serif headlines with optionally one elegant Georgia italic accent. Generous margins, crisp thin rules, clean aligned pricing, true professional German typography. Original blue logo small on warm paper at top. A complete flat poster, no mockup, no device, no paper perspective, no external border.
COMPOSITION: top 22 percent warm paper with logo, eyebrow and large two-line headline; middle 43 percent a full-width architectural photograph from image 2, crop naturally to show the roof, posts and seating, preserve the actual roof/furniture/building composition. Use the supplied photograph as a real photographic insert, do not invent a new project, structure, objects or workers. Bottom 35 percent warm paper with two clearly aligned price columns, readable qualification and a dark graphite CTA bar. Prices are calm typography, not stickers. All content inside safe margins.
EXACT GERMAN TEXT, no other claims:
eyebrow: "TERRASSE & GARTEN · AKTION 2026"
headline: "Mehr draußen.\nMehr Zuhause."
short subline: "Lamellendächer und Pergolen für Ihren Lieblingsplatz."
left price block: "Lamellendach" / "3,0 × 3,0 m" / "ab 5.999 €*"
right price block: "Pergola" / "3,0 × 3,0 m" / "ab 4.999 €*"
process line: "Beratung · Aufmaß · Montage"
CTA: "Jetzt Projekt besprechen" with a small northeast arrow
contact: "klotz.mobi · 03461 455-0 · Merseburg / Meuschau"
footnote: "*Preisbeispiele zzgl. Montage. Endpreis nach Aufmaß und Ausführung."
CONSTRAINTS: keep the two exact prices and dimensions. Do not claim a discount, funding, weather guarantee, awards or a founding year. No smileys, blue sale bubbles, fake QR code, tiny unreadable copy, gradients or excessive rounded cards. Keep the photographed project recognizable and the logo faithful. Make the headline and offers readable at mobile scale. Output a single polished poster.
